description: Codex round 6 P1: negation + bracket pattern. With source `!/g/[.]y`, the inner pattern `/g/[.]y` rejects the path `/g/.y` (minimatch `dot: false` — `[` is magic, NOT a literal `.`); the negation flips the result so the rule FIRES for `/g/.y` while it would NOT fire for any path that the inner pattern actually matches. The pre-round-6 implementation used raw `globset.is_match()` which admitted `.y` (globset's brackets don't follow `dot: false`), so the negation incorrectly rejected `/g/.y`. Isolated to its own probe because `!`-rules match almost any path and would interfere with positive anchors elsewhere.
